extracted.name: Grilled Chicken with Herbs
extracted.description: An herb chicken marinade featuring fresh rosemary, thyme, and sage plus garlic, oil, and balsamic vinegar is all that’s needed for the tastiest chicken!
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons chopped Italian flat leaf parsley
instruction_lines: Blend vinegar, oil, garlic, parsley, rosemary, thyme, sage, salt, and pepper in a blender until well combined. Place chicken in a glass dish or bowl and pour marinade over top. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or up to 48 hours.
When ready to cook, preheat the grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. Remove chicken from marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade.

Cook chicken on the preheated grill until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 6 to 7 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
